Name: Antlers and trophies for your wall - OUTDATED
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: This small mod replaces some of the wall paintings with a set of antlers and skulls. And two world maps as well.
Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS OR MODDROP. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
__________

Hello,

I made a texture mod to match with my other medieval mods ([map](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/466/?tab=3&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodimages%2F%3Fuser%3D0%26id%3D466%26gid%3D1303), [lamp posts](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/473/?) and [buildings](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D419&pUp=1)). I thought this was missing in the game, so I added it to the furniture file. The skulls and antlers on the trophy boards I made myself, the two world maps I found on the internet from an RPG Maker I think.

If you want to combine these with another furniture mod you're using, you can! I've added the .png file in the folder, so you may switch out the assets you really like and combine whatever you want.
Check out this thread with guides on how to do it: click [here](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion-redux.109131/).
Please don't ask me to do it for you, I'ts really simple so you can do it yourself easily :)

How to install:
Find the content folder from Stardew Valley on your computer and place furniture.xnb in TileSheets folder. Let it overwrite the original file (don't forget to make a back up).

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
